desc:
Claim your own canvas, pick a poster, and run across the board to paint it tile by tile! Match the highlighted colors, complete huge pixel posters!

🎨 Claim your own canvas
🏃 Run over tiles to paint
🖼️ Complete movie-style posters
👥 Paint with friends!
🔎 Use hints to find missing blocks
⭐ Finish posters and show them off

Inspired by Paint an Album!
